_meta.description: Keystones — Stigma-style triggers actifs. 4 slots (lv 30/50/70/100). Rangs C→SS. 3 variantes par keystone. v5.2 (2026-07-29) : passe de 5 a 4 slots, premier keystone apres la subclass (lv10 juge trop tot).

rules.rank_interpolation: Valeurs B/A/S interpolees lineairement entre C et SS
design_notes: Objet équipé et retirable, jamais appris ou consommé.
Quatre emplacements ; une variante par famille.
Rangs C à SS : nature identique, valeurs dans runtime/runtime_scaling.
Rôles de matrice : tank, DPS mêlée, DPS physique distance, DPS magique, healer, support buffer, support debuff/entrave.

runtime_contract.equipment: Owned removable instance; one family per character; changes apply on next combat spawn.
runtime_contract.rank_values: runtime is C. runtime_scaling JSON-pointer endpoints interpolate C/B/A/S/SS; integer fields round to nearest integer.
runtime_contract.hp_threshold: Repeatable after cooldown; no per-combat one-shot except prevent_death uses_per_combat.
runtime_contract.snapshot: Economy owns instance equipment; all mutations return full slots and owned items.
runtime_contract.offensive_procs: Direct damage only; periodic damage cannot trigger offensive hit or critical procs.

rules.build_role_notes: Discovery and coverage only; never a class or equipment restriction.
